Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is the classic radiographic presentation of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away. The appropriate next step in management for both diagnosis and symptom relief is therapeutic and diagnostic thoracentesis.
